english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unexpected event or outcome, especially a neutral one.

examples.english: This power outage was a real surprise.
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ting4 din6 zan1 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unexpected harmful accident, especially when it is not specifically a vehicle crash.
Use this when the incident is specifically an accident or unexpected mishap.
Use this for a misfortune that is an accident or other unexpected incident.

examples.english: He slipped while walking; it was a real accident.
examples.traditional: 佢行路跣親，真係一場意外。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 haang4 lou6 sin2 can1 zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6

examples.english: An incident happened at the company yesterday.
examples.traditional: 公司噚日發生咗一宗意外。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 cam4 jat6 faat3 saang1 zo2 jat1 zung1 ji3 ngoi6

examples.english: That accident broke his leg; it was a real misfortune.
examples.traditional: 嗰場意外搞到佢隻腳骨折，真係好唔好彩。
examples.jyutping: go2 coeng4 ji3 ngoi6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 zek3 goek3 gwat1 zit3 zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 hou2 coi2
